theme: Two short calls, then the day opens up in St. Pete.
greeting: A light meeting day with the girls, Dan — but a priority-one Christmas rental has been waiting weeks and is the one thing genuinely worth clearing today.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV — refundable
needsAttention.detail: On your Mike + Dan board, the p1 rental has sat open since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest booking in that market and sells out; a refundable hold costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: Both clocks have passed (decide Sep 30, book Oct 15). All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2 — the thinnest inventory of the year, so a domestic shortlist you can book outright is the safe default.

schedule.title: ICGN Toronto planning call
schedule.detail: Plenary 7 — evolving stewardship data, reporting and impact.

flagged.title: Cold board-advisory outreach
flagged.detail: Elijah A.T. / Aurevane Search pitched a 'board composition brief' with a reply-to-engage hook — reads as low-signal prospecting, not a real search engagement. A LinkedIn KPMG Managing Director auto-alert also came in.

inbox.noise: Otherwise newsletters and promos — NYT Veggie, Italian word of the day, a St. Pete local digest, two Todoist nudges, a Hilton stay survey.
inbox.clear: No security, financial, or health mail needing a reply.

resolved: Coffee Pot Bayou cottage (Oct 22–Nov 2) is squared away on Airbnb — host and co-host wrapped the last check-in details yesterday, nothing left on your side.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: A from-scratch autumn bake the girls can lend a hand with — warm ginger and dried cherries for a St. Pete evening that's finally starting to cool.

Clear and yours, with the girls home in St. Pete.
